Assignment Title: Employee HashMap

Assignment Question:
ABC Company wants to develop a system to maintain employee details. Each employee is identified by a unique employee ID, which will be used as the key, while the employee's salary will be stored as the corresponding value. The company wants to store and manage employee records efficiently and should be able to quickly search for an employee's salary using their employee ID. The system should also allow the user to add, search, update, and remove employee records. Write a Java program using HashMap to perform the following operations:  
- Accept the employee ID and salary from the user and store them in the HashMap. 
- Display all employee records. 
- Search for and display the salary of a specified employee using their employee ID.
- Update the salary of an existing employee using their employee ID.
- Remove an employee using their employee ID.
- Display the updated employee records after the update and removal operations.
Input Validation Conditions
·       The number of employees must be between 1 and 100.
·       Employee ID must be a positive integer.
·       Salary must be greater than 0.
·       Employee ID must be unique while adding employee records.
·       The employee ID used for searching must exist in the HashMap.
·       The employee ID used for updating must exist in the HashMap.
·       The updated salary must be greater than 0.
·       The employee ID used for deletion must exist in the HashMap.
Input Format
·       The first line contains an integer n, representing the number of employees.
·       The next n lines contain the employee ID and salary.
·       The next line contains the employee ID to be searched.
·       The next line contains the employee ID to be updated.
·       The next line contains the new salary.
·       The final line contains the employee ID to be removed.
Output Format
·       Display all employee records.

·       Display the updated employee records.
·       Display the employee records after removing the specified employee.
